name: pr-review
prompt: A new PR was opened: #{pull_request.number} '{pull_request.title}' by {pull_request.user.login} against {pull_request.base.ref}. Walk business/sops/engineering/pr-review.md exactly. Pre-flight checks first — abort with [BLOCKED] if any fail. Post the review as a GitHub comment AND cross-post a one-line summary with the verdict (APPROVE | REQUEST_CHANGES | COMMENT_ONLY) to #eng.
